sam: Quick heads-up: we landed the "adaptive-prefix-dedupe" change in canary this morning. Short summary: p50 ~0%, p95 -7%, p99 -18%, token-cost -9% on convo-heavy traffic for gpt-medium-v1. :tada:

sam: What it does: detects repeated assistant prefixes across turns and serves a compact tokenized surrogate to the decoder, avoiding repeated KV reads and redundant decode steps. Also a tiny proxy trim for duplicated system messages.

anya: Benchmarks?

sam: From our replay run (1% prod sample):
```
baseline: p50 40ms p95 150ms p99 420ms cost=1.00
canary : p50 40ms p95 140ms p99 345ms cost=0.91
```

leo: Nice tail win. Any user-visible regressions?

sam: Ran evals and a 500-case human spot-check. No major semantic changes. We added a safelist for prompts containing explicit repetition instructions. Also min_decodes=4 floor for short replies.

anya: Rollout plan? ops commands?

sam: Canary started on pool-gpu-c (2 instances) at 2025-03-07T07:00:00Z. Rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback on p99 or eval regressions. Ops commands:
```
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-c --tag adaptive-prefix-dedupe/v1 --pct 2
sleep 3600
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-c --tag adaptive-prefix-dedupe/v1 --pct 10
```

ops-bot: deploy: adaptive-prefix-dedupe/v1 -> canary on pool-gpu-c (2 instances) at 2025-03-07T07:00:12Z

leo: Please upload eval CSVs to the bench bucket and add a console tile for "prefix-dedupe hit rate".

sam: Done: s3://ci-redwood/benchmarks/prefix-dedupe/v1, console tile queued. Closing note: dedicated clusters will be opt-in; product will coordinate customer consent.
